options.text: Not for me: I can't ride one

schema.text: If you could use a shared bike or e-scooter for free, would you try it?

ar.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: لو استطعت استخدام دراجة أو سكوتر كهربائي مشترك مجانًا، هل كنت ستجربه؟
ar.#Not for me: I can't ride one: لا ينطبق عليّ: لا أستطيع ركوب أي منهما

de.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: Würden Sie ein Leihfahrrad oder einen Leih-E-Scooter ausprobieren, wenn Sie es kostenlos nutzen könnten?
de.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Trifft auf mich nicht zu: Ich kann so etwas nicht fahren

en.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: If you could use a shared bike or e-scooter for free, would you try it?
en.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Not for me: I can't ride one

fa.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: اگر می‌توانستید از دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی اشتراکی رایگان استفاده کنید، آن را امتحان می‌کردید؟
fa.#Not for me: I can't ride one: مربوط به من نیست: نمی‌توانم سوار آن شوم

fr.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: Si vous pouviez utiliser gratuitement un vélo ou une trottinette électrique en libre-service, l'essaieriez-vous ?
fr.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Cela ne me concerne pas : je ne peux pas en faire

hu.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: Ha ingyen használhatna megosztott kerékpárt vagy elektromos rollert, kipróbálná?
hu.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Rám nem vonatkozik: nem tudok ilyet használni

it.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: Se potessi usare gratis una bici o un monopattino elettrico in condivisione, lo proveresti?
it.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Non mi riguarda: non posso usarli

tr.#If you could use a shared bike or e-sco: Paylaşımlı bir bisikleti veya elektrikli scooter'ı ücretsiz kullanabilseydiniz denemek ister miydiniz?
tr.#Not for me: I can't ride one: Bu soru benim için geçerli değil: Kullanamam
